primaryOutcome.summary: The bounded Angular Length/Angle/Fence offset slice is implemented, its declared test/typecheck/build validation passed, and migration-result.json plus work-item-migration.json validate against the Flow Contract.

observations.observation: validate-handoff.mjs throws an uncaught TypeError ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading includes)') instead of a structured validation error when a migration-result.json includes any 'checkpoints' entry while the Flow Contract's checkpointPolicy has no 'milestones' array (this contract's checkpointPolicy is only {mode: 'disabled', pushPolicy: 'never'}, with no 'milestones' key at all). The first migration-result.json draft recorded one 'skipped' checkpoint entry to document that checkpointPolicy.mode is disabled; validation crashed instead of naming the rule, so a second attempt with an empty checkpoints array was needed before the artifact validated.
evidence: First validate-handoff.mjs invocation on migration-result.json threw: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading includes)' at validateArtifactLinks (scripts/validate-handoff.mjs:1168), inside 'for (const checkpoint of migration.value.checkpoints) { if (!contract.value.checkpointPolicy.milestones.includes(...',
flow-contract.json's checkpointPolicy is {"mode": "disabled", "pushPolicy": "never"} with no 'milestones' property.
Removing the checkpoints entry (using an empty array) let the same migration-result.json validate cleanly on the next attempt.

observations.observation: Diagnosing the checkpoints/milestones crash above required reading scripts/validate-handoff.mjs around the throwing line, since the error was an uncaught TypeError rather than a named validation rule. Per the skill's own reading-discipline guidance this is the sanctioned fallback when an error doesn't name a fix and a retry doesn't resolve it, but it still cost a source read of the validator that a clearer error message (e.g. treating a missing checkpointPolicy.milestones as 'no milestones approved' rather than dereferencing it) would have avoided.
evidence: Read scripts/validate-handoff.mjs:1130-1180 to find the exact line dereferencing checkpointPolicy.milestones before retrying with an empty checkpoints array.

observations.observation: Cross-referencing artifacts (flow-contract.json, work-item-baseline.json, migration-result.json) required manually running Get-FileHash three separate times and hand-copying the lowercase hex digest into the next artifact's JSON. This is a fully deterministic step (hash a file, insert the value) that a small script (e.g. 'scripts/hash-artifact.mjs <path>' or an option on validate-handoff.mjs to print the expected hash) would remove entirely, and would also remove the risk of a copy/paste mismatch.
evidence: Ran Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 on flow-contract.json and work-item-baseline.json before writing migration-result.json.
Ran Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 on migration-result.json again after it stabilized, to fill work-item-migration.json's primaryArtifact.sha256.
